sentences.text:
This is an application under Section 439 CrPC praying for releasing the Page No.# 2/2 petitioner,
namely, Sri Anirban Saikia, who was arrested in connection with North Guwahati P.S. Case No.
47/2023 under Section 406/420/294/506 IPC.
It was alleged in the FIR that the petitioner had taken money from different persons with a promise to give them financial benefits.
Accordingly, financial benefits were given for a considerable period of time.
After that financial benefits stop coming to the investors and when the investors asked for return of the principal amount, which was not returned.
The petitioner has completed 12 days in custody.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties in the light of the materials available on record, this court is of the opinion that the investors have other forum to seek relief and for that matter, the petitioner does not deserve to be detained in custody for any further period of time.
Accordingly, the bail prayer of the petitioner is allowed.
It is hereby provided that the petitioner abovenamed in connection with the aforesaid case, he shall be released on bail of Rs. 20,000/- with one suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned CJM, Kamrup, Amingaon.
The bail application is disposed of.
